component.name: Glypdl
component.summary: A lightweight native Linux graphical frontend for yt-dlp

description.p: Glypdl is a fast, native GTK4/libadwaita download manager that interfaces seamlessly with yt-dlp. Designed for modern GNOME desktop environments, it offers rich download controls, format selection, network throughput metrics, download queuing, playlist batch management, and complete download history tracking.

ul.li: Native GNOME/libadwaita look and feel with dark/light mode support
Audio-only, Video-only, and Video+Audio download modes
Interactive YouTube playlist downloading with selective checkboxes
Smooth real-time network throughput and ETA calculations
History tracking powered by a local SQLite database
Saved Netscape cookie profiles and authentication recovery dialog
Zero web wrappers or heavy runtimes

screenshot.caption: Active downloads queue with live speed and progress metrics
Video metadata preview and format selection
Clean main window with quick URL input
Persistent download history with instant search and context actions

description.p: Initial release of Glypdl native GTK4/libadwaita yt-dlp download manager.
